top_selection.comment: A package is 'top' if it falls within the top X% of cumulative download mass in its ecosystem

downloads_score.comment: downloads_score = debian_weight*debian_avg + homebrew_weight*homebrew_avg. Default ratio 1.39:1 is inverse of ecosystem totals (debian ~181.9M vs homebrew ~252.8M annual installs) so a 'typical' package from either ecosystem contributes equally.

value_classes.comment: Cumulative PageRank share intervals [lo, hi] per class (upper bound inclusive). Class A (<=75%) is also the risk-pipeline input scope; see risk_input.value_classes.

risk_input.comment: Risk pipeline runs on valid class-A repos (value/value.csv class == 'A'). Kept as the documented risk scope; load_top_repos reads top_repos below.

top_repos.comment: load_top_repos scope — a value.csv row is a 'top repo' iff platform in platforms AND class in classes AND git_valid==True. GitHub + GitLab: the risk builders rank each percentile-based dimension over the full top-repo population (github + gitlab together — platform does not matter), so GitLab repos rank in alongside GitHub. classes must match risk_input.value_classes.

value_score.comment: value.csv `score` = criticality_weight*(openssf_crit*100) + centrality_weight*top_eco_pct, range 0-100. openssf_crit is the OpenSSF criticality score (0-1); top_eco_pct is the repo's PageRank percentile in its top ecosystem (0-100, already a percentile). Weights should sum to 1; criticality-dominant so a foundational-but-quiet micro-dep can't outrank a genuinely critical project. Only computed where openssf_crit is present (valid class-A GitHub).

concentration.comment: window_years: '_5y' window length in complete years anchored to max(years) (the last complete year); '_full' = all commits through max(years). bus_factor_threshold: commit-share that defines the bus factor (0.5 = the fewest contributors covering 50% of commits). concentration.csv column names stay year-agnostic (_5y / _full); the year boundary lives here, not in the schema.
